requirements_summary: High-level: ingest 300M–700M vectors (images + text + user signals). Expected steady-state QPS 800–2,500 (diurnal spikes to 8k). SLOs: p95 end-to-end <150ms for combined retrieval+rerank for prioritized routes. Cost targets: <$0.001/query average, opportunistic <$0.0005 for read-heavy routes via batching/caching. Must support model routing (cheap dense candidate gen on small model + heavy cross-encoder rerank fallback), automated prefix/KV caching, and deterministic rollbacks for model rollouts. Compliance: SOC2, SSO/SAML for SRE, audit log retention 7 years for regulated catalogs, EU data residency for certain tenant shards. Integration: Kafka-based ingestion, S3 archive snapshots, Elastic-style metadata store.
